purpose: test whether the 4096-row AcceptedV2 training sample is an adequate inference support axis

axes.sparse: the exact immutable 4096 AcceptedV2 canonical rows
axes.dense: all scale-major SurfaceRegionV2 candidates at radii 0.25, 0.45, and 0.70 metres over the same support graph

target_construction.authority: ScanNet source 2D instance labels registered by the immutable exact-marginal responsibility authority
target_construction.eligible_instances: every positive instance with at least one observed primitive

selection.algorithm: the same deterministic greedy primitive-IoU union used by the sealed LERF D3 development oracle

metrics.primary: equal-instance macro primitive IoU after up to eight regions

decision.if_sparse_axis_failure_signal: decouple the compact source-training row sample from the dense inference support axis
decision.otherwise: retain AcceptedV2 as the support axis and focus on semantic ranking and bounded readout
